comments.body: 2026-10-23 re-triage: moved to backlog-hi. It is a reported bug on 0.18.0 that misleads a script launching a helper: a maker that posts its brief on idle and treats blocked as stuck would decide the helper never got past its dialog. Same family as a_2luRHNGh6 (done).

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-23 on 0.18.0, on the Linux devenv. A maker started a Codex helper with `muster pane new --helper --run ' ...'` in a folder Codex had not trusted yet. The pane read `blocked` at Codex's folder-trust dialog, which was right. The maker answered it with `muster pane send --pane

--key enter`, then ran `muster pane wait --pane

--until idle,blocked --timeout 120`. The wait printed `

blocked` at once, while `muster pane read` showed Codex already at its empty prompt. A moment later `muster window` showed the pane as `done` with "(adapter not reporting)", and the adapter began reporting (context %) only after the first message woke the agent. So a wait sent just after the keypress answers from the state the keypress ended. A script that posts its brief on idle and treats blocked as "still stuck" would decide the helper never got past the dialog. Possibly: after a `pane send` that answers a dialog, treat the pane's state as unknown until a new screen has been read, as for a freshly started agent. Related, fixed: a_2luRHNGh6 (pane wait --until blocked answering from a stale blocked mid-turn).
title: pane wait --until idle,blocked answers blocked right after the dialog was answered
